frame_image_note: Co hieu ung quet sang dau video, quet het khung o ~frame 13-15/129, nhung ngay sau do la mot dot no tuyet (snow burst) tu chan san pham bay tung toe che kin san pham tu ~frame 15 den ~frame 50. Khong the lay base ngay luc quet xong vi san pham bi tuyet che gan nhu hoan toan. Lay frame 60: dot no tuyet da lang xuong thanh dong tuyet on dinh o chan + lop tuyet mong tren nap, nen trang sach, chi con vai bong tuyet nho roi nhe trong khong khi -- san pham hien ro day du.
effect_prompt: A sudden burst of fine snow explodes around the base of the product as if it has just landed in deep snow, with powder and flurries bursting upward and outward before settling. The snow gradually calms into a soft snowdrift that cradles the base of the product, leaving a light dusting of snow on its upper surfaces, while gentle snowflakes continue drifting and falling slowly through the air. The camera remains completely fixed, framing the product centered throughout, and the product itself never moves or rotates. Clean plain white background, soft bright lighting.
effect_prompt_note: Quan sat cac khung trai deu 129 khung/24fps: frame13-20 dot no tuyet bung manh ngay sau vet quet, tuyet bay tung toe che gan het san pham; frame30-50 bot tuyet van con day dac, nen con hoi mo; frame60 tro di dot no da lang xuong hoan toan thanh dong tuyet on dinh o chan san pham + lop tuyet mong tren nap, nen trang sach, chi con vai bong tuyet nho roi nhe -- trang thai nay giu on dinh toi frame120 (khong doi them mau/hieu ung). Camera KHONG di chuyen, san pham khong xoay.
